lyrics:
[Intro: soft electric guitar, finger snaps, hummed harmony]

[Verse 1: soft male tenor, close]
You used to hate olives, now you eat 'em from the jar
You used to love the city, now you want to see the stars
You cried at that movie, the one you called dumb
I thought I had you memorized. I'm nowhere near done.

[Chorus: stacked harmonies, light beat]
So what's your favorite now?
Favorite song, favorite side of the bed
What's keeping you up, what's stuck in your head?
I'll ask you again when the leaves come down
Tell me, baby, what's your favorite now?

[Verse 2: tenor, a little fuller]
Twenty-five years, I should know you cold
Then you take up the fiddle at fifty years old
You changed your coffee, you changed your hair
I just keep on learning and you keep on being there

[Chorus: stacked harmonies, light beat]
So what's your favorite now?
Favorite song, favorite side of the bed
What's keeping you up, what's stuck in your head?
I'll ask you again when the leaves come down
Tell me, baby, what's your favorite now?

[Bridge: beat drops, voices only]
People say they know each other like a book
But you keep adding pages
I keep taking a look

[Final Chorus: full harmonies, beat returns]
So what's your favorite now?
Favorite song, favorite side of the bed
What's keeping you up, what's stuck in your head?
I'll ask you again when the leaves come down
Tell me, baby, what's your favorite now?

[Outro: hummed harmony, guitar, spoken]
Still olives?
Still olives.
